subject: pe
title: Lactate Threshold
welcome_lead: When lactic acid begins to flood — find your tipping point.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on lactate threshold and anaerobic glycolysis.
final_note: Lactate threshold is the practical engine governing race pace.

concepts.def: Workload at which blood lactate rises sharply above baseline.
Onset of blood lactate accumulation; ~4 mmol L⁻¹.
Glucose → pyruvate → lactate; ATP without O₂.
Untrained ~50–60%; elite endurance athletes ~80–90% of VO₂max.
Lactate transported from glycolytic to oxidative fibres for fuel.
Bicarbonate neutralising H⁺ to prevent acidosis.

walkthroughs.body_html: Below threshold, lactate clears as fast as produced. Above, it accumulates exponentially.
Endurance training raises threshold by increasing mitochondrial density, capillarisation and lactate clearance.
Trained athletes have higher bicarbonate buffering and improved H⁺ removal via MCT transporters.
